locations.name: Restaurante Nacarat
locations.description: Family-run restaurant on Carrer de sa Lluna, Sóller's shopping street — kitchen open straight through 12:00–21:30 Wednesday–Sunday (closed Mon/Tue), which makes it a rare all-hours option after the 1912 train or the Fornalutx drive. Featured on Sara Caroline Bridgers' Sóller train-day reel; a few doors from Miga de Nube, so coffee-then-lunch happens on one street. Online reservations (myrestoo) or +34 971 63 48 38.
locations.address: Carrer de sa Lluna, 80, 07100 Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

locations.name: Miga de Nube
locations.description: "Secret garden" slow-café on Carrer de sa Lluna in Sóller for iced coffee and cake — now featured twice by Sara Caroline Bridgers (her original 4/5 recommendation and again on her 1912-train day reel). A few doors from Restaurante Nacarat, making the street a natural coffee-then-lunch pairing on a Sóller train day.

locations.name: Ferrocarril de Sóller (1912 train)
locations.description: Vintage 1912 wooden train from Palma through the Tramuntana to Sóller, about an hour each way — roughly $46 round trip; buy tickets a day ahead. Sara Caroline Bridgers has now endorsed it twice: "one of the best parts… do not miss this" and, in her later post, "easily one of my favorite things we have done in Mallorca." The natural anchor for a Sóller day during the Palma leg (Sep 3–7), chaining to sa Lluna street (Miga de Nube coffee, Nacarat lunch), the tram to Port de Sóller, or the Fornalutx loop.
locations.address: Carrer d'Eusebi Estada, 1, 07004 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain
